concepts.name: Economic Development
concepts.description: A process broader than economic growth that encompasses improvements in living standards, health, education, institutional capability, and human capital rather than relying solely on GDP output.

concepts.name: Income Inequality
concepts.description: The distribution of income across individuals or households, measured using tools such as the Gini coefficient, and distinct from poverty which concerns resource thresholds.

concepts.name: Environmental Externalities and Sustainable Growth
concepts.description: Economic activities that impose uncompensated social costs or benefits, such as pollution or resource depletion, requiring policy interventions like taxes, permits, or regulation to ensure sustainable growth.

concepts.name: Scarcity and Opportunity Cost
concepts.description: Scarcity is the condition of limited resources relative to unlimited wants, while opportunity cost is the value of the next best alternative forgone when a choice is made.

concepts.name: Supply, Demand, and Market Equilibrium
concepts.description: Demand and supply represent consumer and producer willingness and ability to trade at various prices, reaching equilibrium when quantity demanded equals quantity supplied.

concepts.name: Elasticity
concepts.description: A measure of the responsiveness of one economic variable to a percentage change in another variable.

concepts.name: Gross Domestic Product (GDP)
concepts.description: The market value of final goods and services produced within a country's borders during a specified period.

concepts.name: Inflation
concepts.description: A sustained increase in the general price level of goods and services over time.

concepts.name: Fiscal Policy
concepts.description: Government decisions concerning spending, taxation, and borrowing designed to influence aggregate economic activity.

concepts.name: Monetary Policy
concepts.description: Actions undertaken by a central monetary authority to regulate financial conditions and achieve macroeconomic goals.
